description: This Java source file defines a helper logging class `Log` that abstracts and simplifies logging operations within an Android project. It provides static methods to log messages at various priority levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), manages chaining of custom LogNode objects for customizable log handling, and contains constants for each log level. The class acts as a replacement or wrapper for Android's native `android.util.Log`, facilitating easier and more flexible logging throughout the app.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for flexible logging and log node management within Android applications.
